hooks.command: FILE=$(node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook-input.mjs"); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.env.example|*.env.sample|*.env.template) exit 0;; *.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit .env files — use environment variables via vercel env or service .env.example files instead' >&2; exit 2;; *pnpm-lock.yaml) echo 'BLOCK: Never edit pnpm-lock.yaml directly — run pnpm install instead' >&2; exit 2;; */prisma/migrations/*/migration.sql) echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit existing migrations — create a new migration with prisma migrate dev instead' >&2; exit 2;; */infrastructure/pulumi/Pulumi.prod.yaml) echo 'BLOCK: Production Pulumi config requires manual review' >&2; exit 2;; esac
FILE=$(node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook-input.mjs"); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$FILE" ] || exit 0; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$FILE" || true
FILE=$(node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook-input.mjs"); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$FILE" ] || exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx eslint --fix "$FILE" || true;; esac

FILE=$(node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/hook-input.mjs"); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; case "$FILE" in */migrations/*/migration.sql|*/prisma/migrations/*/migration.sql) if grep -iqE 'DROP TABLE|DROP COLUMN|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM|ALTER TABLE .+ DROP' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -iqE '^-- DESTRUCTIVE:' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚠️  Destructive migration detected without a -- DESTRUCTIVE: <reason> marker. Add the marker or redesign as a shadow-column-then-drop-later pattern before committing.' >&2; fi;; esac
